#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
mkdir -p build/wobble-combined
for mode in normal sanitized; do
 flags="-O2"
 if [ "$mode" = sanitized ]; then flags="-O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all"; fi
 ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 $flags -Wall -Wextra -Werror -ffp-contract=off -DX0X_SYNTH_HOST_TEST -Ifirmware/src tests/host/wobble_backend_test.c experiments/wobble/wobble.c firmware/src/dsp/bass303.c -o build/wobble-combined/$mode
 build/wobble-combined/$mode
done
# Product path: WBL1 allowed without PADCAL / with VERSION. Off still excludes backend.
if printf '#include "dsp/wobble_backend.h"\n' | ${CC:-cc} -x c -E -Ifirmware/src -DX0X_WOBBLE=0 - >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; fi
if ! printf '#include "dsp/wobble_config.h"\n' | ${CC:-cc} -x c -E -Ifirmware/src -DX0X_WOBBLE=1 -DX0X_DEV_PADCAL=0 - >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; fi
if ! printf '#include "dsp/wobble_config.h"\n' | ${CC:-cc} -x c -E -Ifirmware/src -DX0X_WOBBLE=1 -DX0X_VERSION=1 - >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; fi
echo 'PASS default/backend and product WBL1 enable'

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, hashlib

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
q = root / "build/wobble-independent-mix"
q.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

engine = (root / "firmware/src/app/engine.c").read_text()
wrapper = q / "exact_engine_wrapper.c"
wrapper.write_text(
    '#include "'
    + str(root / "firmware/src/app/engine.c")
    + '"\nvoid qa_stereo(void){wobble_set(&dev_wobble,W_STEREO,1.0f);}\n'
)

dev_decl = "static wobble_t dev_wobble POOL;"
if dev_decl not in engine:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: unexpected dev_wobble declaration in engine.c")
ref = engine.replace(dev_decl, dev_decl + "\nstatic float qa_right[2][256];")
ref = ref.replace("bb[1 - b]", "qa_right[b]")
if "bb[1 - b]" in ref:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: bb[1 - b] still present after reference rewrite")
ref = (
    ref.replace('#include "../', '#include "')
    .replace('#include "engine.h"', '#include "app/engine.h"')
    .replace('#include "plat.h"', '#include "app/plat.h"')
)
ref += "\nvoid qa_stereo(void){wobble_set(&dev_wobble,W_STEREO,1.0f);}\n"
(q / "reference_engine.c").write_text(ref)

host = (root / "host/x0x_host.c").read_text().replace(
    '"../firmware/', '"' + str(root / "firmware") + "/"
)
host = host.replace(
    '        if (!strcmp(cmd, "wait"))',
    '        if (!strcmp(cmd,"qa_stereo")) qa_stereo();\n        else if (!strcmp(cmd, "wait"))',
)
host = "void qa_stereo(void);\n" + host
(q / "qa_host.c").write_text(host)

scenario_path = root / "tests/scenarios/synth_engine_regression.x0x"
if scenario_path.is_file():
    sc = scenario_path.read_text()
else:
    sc = """wait 300
load 0
wav adapter-equivalence.wav
param 2 0 0 99
param 2 0 1 84
param 2 0 8 96
param 2 0 9 2
param 2 1 5 127
param 2 1 0 110
param 2 1 1 90
key w2 down
wait 160
key w6 down
wait 90
key w2 up
wait 90
key w6 up
wait 600
load 99
key w4 down
wait 400
key w4 up
wait 1200
load 0
param 2 0 12 100
param 2 0 13 80
param 2 0 14 110
key w3 down
wait 600
key w3 up
wait 1700
wavstop
"""
sc = sc.replace("load 0", "load 0\nqa_stereo", 1)
sc = sc.replace("turn ALGO 2\n", "")
sc = sc.replace("tap PLAY\nwait 2000\ntap PLAY\n", "")
(q / "side-sends.x0x").write_text(sc)

units = "firmware/src/dsp/drum909.c firmware/src/dsp/drum808.c firmware/src/dsp/x0x_param.c firmware/src/dsp/bass303.c firmware/src/dsp/breaks.c firmware/src/dsp/fxbus.c firmware/src/dsp/master.c firmware/src/seq/sequencer.c firmware/src/seq/tb3po.c firmware/src/seq/pattern.c firmware/src/seq/motion.c experiments/wobble/wobble.c".split()
flags = [
    "-O2",
    "-ffp-contract=off",
    "-std=c99",
    "-Wall",
    "-Wextra",
    "-Wno-unused-function",
    "-Wno-unused-parameter",
    "-DX0X_HOST",
    "-D_DARWIN_C_SOURCE",
    "-DX0X_DEV_PADCAL=1",
    "-DX0X_DEV_WOBBLE=1",
    "-Ifirmware/src",
    "-Ifirmware/src/app",
    "-Ifirmware/src/dsp",
    "-Ibuild/gen",
]
for name, src in [("side_exact", wrapper), ("side_reference", q / "reference_engine.c")]:
    exe = q / name
    out = q / (name + "-render")
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    subprocess.run(
        ["clang"] + flags + [str(q / "qa_host.c")] + units + [str(src), "-lm", "-o", str(exe)],
        check=True,
    )
    subprocess.run([str(exe), str(q / "side-sends.x0x"), str(out)], check=True)
a = (q / "side_exact-render/adapter-equivalence.wav").read_bytes()
b = (q / "side_reference-render/adapter-equivalence.wav").read_bytes()
assert a == b
print(
    "PASS exact sequential scratch mixer equals independent dedicated planar arrays with nonzero side and sends:",
    len(a),
    hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(),
)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Bounded real-breaks_render host callback latency experiment, R22 vs R23.

Run with exact pinned source projection directories; unchanged source is never
modified. Timer and decoder counters exist only in scratch benchmark fixtures.
No claim about MCU CPU cycles, XRUNs, or hardware is made by this runner.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import run_breaks_dual_voice_decoder_compare as base

SOURCE = 'firmware/src/dsp/breaks.c'
TEST = 'tests/host/breaks_reverse_fast_advance_test.c'
BEFORE = '9e1e607e2ddc3028383bfb6ebc85fbc7ac6864c5'
AFTER = '01e0e759d2b8be3b028e0e25d4f93348a36aeb46'
RUNNER_R22 = '4a285e80482c266abc4ac818b4b0ff0910a4930c'
HEAD_PR93 = 'a7f56778cf24a1c933a8f507eaf0728a7f524614'
FIRMWARE_TREE = '75723d43185b1b7aeeaf4c50615e4381ce623a6c'
TIMER_FUNC = '''
static uint64_t host_clock_ns(void) {
    struct timespec ts;
    if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts)) { perror("clock_gettime"); exit(3); }
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * UINT64_C(1000000000) + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
}
'''


def change_once(s, old, new):
    if s.count(old) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Expected exactly one anchor: ' + old[:90])
    return s.replace(old, new, 1)


def build_fixture(source, clock):
    s = change_once(source, '#include <inttypes.h>',
                    '#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L\n#include <time.h>\n#include <inttypes.h>')
    s = change_once(s, 'static uint32_t rnd(', TIMER_FUNC.replace('CLOCK_MONOTONIC', clock) + '\nstatic uint32_t rnd(')
    s = change_once(s, 'uint64_t per_block[BLOCKS],sum=0,max=0,overlap=0,hash=',
                    'uint64_t render_ns[BLOCKS],per_block[BLOCKS],sum=0,max=0,overlap=0,hash=')
    s = change_once(s, '        breaks_render(b,out,BLOCK);',
                    '        const uint64_t t0=host_clock_ns();\n'
                    '        breaks_render(b,out,BLOCK);\n'
                    '        render_ns[j]=host_clock_ns()-t0;')
    s = change_once(s, '    qsort(per_block,BLOCKS,sizeof(per_block[0]),cmp_u64);',
                    '    qsort(per_block,BLOCKS,sizeof(per_block[0]),cmp_u64);\n'
                    '    qsort(render_ns,BLOCKS,sizeof(render_ns[0]),cmp_u64);\n'
                    '    uint64_t render_total_ns=0;\n'
                    '    for(int k=0;k<BLOCKS;++k)render_total_ns+=render_ns[k];')
    s = change_once(s, ' overlap=%" PRIu64 " stopped=1\\n",',
                    ' overlap=%" PRIu64 " render_total_ns=%" PRIu64 " render_p50_ns=%" PRIu64 '
                    ' " render_p95_ns=%" PRIu64 " render_p99_ns=%" PRIu64 '
                    ' " render_max_ns=%" PRIu64 " stopped=1\\n",')
    s = change_once(s, 'hash,audible,overlap);',
                    'hash,audible,overlap,render_total_ns,render_ns[BLOCKS/2],'
                    'render_ns[(BLOCKS-1)*95/100],render_ns[(BLOCKS-1)*99/100],'
                    'render_ns[BLOCKS-1]);')
    return s


def run(cmd, log_path, timeout=130):
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout, check=False)
    log_path.write_text('command='+json.dumps(cmd)+'\nexit='+str(p.returncode)+
                        '\nstdout:\n'+p.stdout+'\nstderr:\n'+p.stderr)
    return p


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--before-root', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--after-root', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--output-dir', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--repetitions', type=int, default=7)
    p.add_argument('--clock', choices=('process_cpu','monotonic'), default='process_cpu')
    a = p.parse_args()
    if not (3 <= a.repetitions <= 15):
        p.error('repetitions must be 3..15')
    if a.output_dir.exists():
        p.error('will not overwrite evidence output')
    roots = {'before': a.before_root.resolve(), 'after': a.after_root.resolve()}
    pins = {**base.COMMON, **base.RENDERERS['pr93'], TEST:base.TEST_BLOB}
    if base.blob(Path(base.__file__).read_bytes()) != RUNNER_R22:
        raise ValueError('R22 runner identity mismatch')
    for variant,root in roots.items():
        expected_code = BEFORE if variant == 'before' else AFTER
        for path,sha in {**pins,SOURCE:expected_code}.items():
            actual = base.blob((root/path).read_bytes())
            if actual != sha:raise ValueError(variant+' invalid blob '+path+': '+actual+' != '+sha)
    a.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    started = time.monotonic()
    measurements = {compiler:{kind:[] for kind in roots} for compiler in ('gcc','clang')}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='x0x-r25-render-latency-') as td:
        temp=Path(td)
        for variant,root in roots.items():
            work=temp/variant
            for name in {**pins,SOURCE:None}:
                dst=work/name;dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copyfile(root/name,dst)
            fixture=(work/TEST).read_text()
            fixture=change_once(fixture,base.ORIGINAL_RATES,base.MUSICAL_RATES)
            fixture=change_once(fixture,base.ORIGINAL_SIZES,base.LONG_SIZES)
            fixture=base.live_crossfade_fixture(fixture)
            (work/TEST).write_text(build_fixture(fixture, 'CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID' if a.clock=='process_cpu' else 'CLOCK_MONOTONIC'))
            hdr=work/'firmware/src/dsp/ima_adpcm.h'
            s=hdr.read_text()
            s=change_once(s,'#include <stdint.h>',
                          '#include <stdint.h>\nextern volatile uint64_t x0x_host_ima_decode_calls;')
            s=change_once(s,base.FUNC,base.FUNC+'\n    ++x0x_host_ima_decode_calls;')
            hdr.write_text(s)
            for compiler in measurements:
                tag=compiler+'-'+variant
                exe=work/tag
                cmd=[compiler,'-std=c11','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-pedantic',
                     '-ffp-contract=off','-I'+str(work),str(work/TEST),str(work/SOURCE),'-lm',
                     '-o',str(exe)]
                z=run(cmd,a.output_dir/(tag+'.compile.log'))
                if z.returncode:raise RuntimeError(tag+' compile exit '+str(z.returncode)+' '+z.stderr[:500])
                neg=run([str(exe)],a.output_dir/(tag+'.negative.log'))
                if neg.returncode!=2:raise RuntimeError(tag+' invalid command should exit 2')
        # Paired alternating execution reduces but does not remove scheduling noise.
        for compiler in measurements:
            for trial in range(a.repetitions):
                for variant in (('before','after') if trial%2==0 else ('after','before')):
                    exe=temp/variant/(compiler+'-'+variant)
                    trace=a.output_dir/(f'{compiler}-{variant}-{trial}.pcm')
                    z=run([str(exe),'--check','--trace',str(trace)],
                          a.output_dir/(f'{compiler}-{variant}-{trial}.run.log'))
                    if z.returncode:raise RuntimeError(compiler+'/'+variant+' failed: '+z.stderr[:500])
                    expected_bytes=48*80*64*4
                    if trace.stat().st_size!=expected_bytes:raise RuntimeError('unexpected PCM trace length')
                    total=0; rev=0;fwd=0; reverse_overlap=0; keys=[]; controls=[]
                    for line in z.stdout.splitlines():
                        row=dict(x.split('=',1) for x in line.split())
                        if row.get('stopped')!='1' or int(row['audible'])<1:raise RuntimeError('missing audio or STOP')
                        key='/'.join(row[k] for k in ('n','direction','rate','trial'))
                        if key in keys:raise RuntimeError('duplicate workload case')
                        keys.append(key)
                        controls.append((key,row['pcm'],row['setup'],row['decodes'],row['overlap'],row['max']))
                        t=int(row['render_total_ns'])
                        total+=t
                        if row['direction']=='R':rev+=t;reverse_overlap+=int(row['overlap'])
                        else:fwd+=t
                        if not (int(row['render_p50_ns'])<=int(row['render_p95_ns'])<=int(row['render_p99_ns'])<=int(row['render_max_ns'])):
                            raise RuntimeError('invalid per-case latency quantiles')
                    if len(keys)!=48 or reverse_overlap==0:raise RuntimeError('missing dual voice stress cases')
                    digest=hashlib.sha256(trace.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                    trace.unlink()
                    measurements[compiler][variant].append({'trial':trial,'render_total_ns':total,
                        'reverse_ns':rev,'forward_ns':fwd,'trace_sha256':digest,'controls':controls})
    results={}
    for compiler,groups in measurements.items():
        before,after=groups['before'],groups['after']
        for i in range(a.repetitions):
            if before[i]['trace_sha256']!=after[i]['trace_sha256']:
                raise RuntimeError(compiler+' PCM mismatch '+str(i))
            if before[i]['controls']!=after[i]['controls']:
                raise RuntimeError(compiler+' control/counter mismatch '+str(i))
        entry={'pcm_sha256':before[0]['trace_sha256'],'runs':a.repetitions,
               'reverse_median_ms':{},'forward_median_ms':{},'all_median_ms':{},
               'paired_reverse_speedup_percent':[],
               'producer_only':True}
        for key,dst in (('reverse_ns','reverse_median_ms'),('forward_ns','forward_median_ms'),('render_total_ns','all_median_ms')):
            for variant,obs in groups.items():
                entry[dst][variant]=round(statistics.median(x[key] for x in obs)/1e6,3)
        for x,y in zip(before,after):
            entry['paired_reverse_speedup_percent'].append(round((x['reverse_ns']-y['reverse_ns'])/x['reverse_ns']*100,3))
        entry['paired_reverse_speedup_median_percent']=round(statistics.median(entry['paired_reverse_speedup_percent']),3)
        results[compiler]=entry
    doc={'scope':'native host timed production-linked breaks_render callbacks; R22 vs R23 unmodified production C',
         'new_source_compiled':False,'source_pr_head':HEAD_PR93,'firmware_tree':FIRMWARE_TREE,
         'source_blobs':{'before_breaks.c':BEFORE,'after_breaks.c':AFTER,**pins},
         'environment':{'kernel':os.uname().release,'cpu':os.uname().machine,
                        'gcc':subprocess.check_output(['gcc','-dumpfullversion'],text=True).strip(),
                        'clang':subprocess.check_output(['clang','--version'],text=True).splitlines()[0]},
         'execution':{'repetitions':a.repetitions,'workload_cases_per_execution':48,'callbacks_per_execution':3840,
                      'clock':a.clock+' around breaks_render; includes symmetric instrumentation'},
         'results':results,'elapsed_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),
         'cautions':['host scheduling jitter: no fixed CPU/clock or RTOS preemption',
                     'timer/counter instrumentation affects timings but is identical in both candidates',
                     'no CPU cycle/XRUN/hardware inference','sanitizer not run: inherited fastmath.h failure PR28',
                     'no fresh Elite/Pro/controller compilation or independent QA']}
    (a.output_dir/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(doc,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:{'paired_speedup_median_percent':v['paired_reverse_speedup_median_percent'],
                          'reverse_median_ms':v['reverse_median_ms'],'forward_median_ms':v['forward_median_ms']}
                      for k,v in results.items()},indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:main()
    except (OSError,ValueError,RuntimeError,subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as e:
        print('FAIL:',e,file=sys.stderr);sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Restore safety: never rewrite a later slot after earlier readback failure.

Run with: python3 tests/x0x_slots_verify_order_test.py
Uses host mocks only; no USB, firmware, flash or device is required.
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools"))
import x0x_slots as xs  # noqa: E402


class Link:
    def __init__(self, corrupt=None):
        self.corrupt = corrupt
        self.events = []
        self.slots = {}


def layout(link):
    link.events.append(("info",))
    return {"count": 2, "slots": [{"nz": 1}, {"nz": 1}]}


def plan_restore(lay, meta, images, only=None):
    return [(k, img) for k, img in enumerate(images) if only is None or k + 1 in only], []


def write_slot(link, k, img, progress=None):
    link.events.append(("begin", k))
    link.slots[k] = img
    link.events.append(("end", k))


def read_slot(link, k, nz):
    link.events.append(("read", k))
    return b"corrupt" if link.corrupt == k else link.slots[k]


def check(condition, label):
    print(f"{'PASS' if condition else 'FAIL'}: {label}")
    return 0 if condition else 1


def main():
    fails = 0
    images = [b"first-slot-image", b"second-slot-image"]
    with patch.object(xs, "layout", layout), patch.object(xs, "plan_restore", plan_restore), \
            patch.object(xs, "write_slot", write_slot), patch.object(xs, "read_slot", read_slot):
        for label, operation in (
            ("regular", lambda link, **kw: xs.restore(link, {}, images, **kw)),
            ("migration", lambda link, **kw: xs.restore_mapped(link, [(0, 0), (1, 1)], images, **kw)),
        ):
            link = Link(corrupt=0)
            try:
                operation(link)
                fails += check(False, f"{label}: failed first readback must raise SlotError")
            except xs.SlotError:
                fails += check(True, f"{label}: first readback mismatch reported")
            fails += check(("begin", 1) not in link.events and link.slots.get(1) is None,
                           f"{label}: mismatch must not erase/write second slot")
            fails += check(link.events.index(("read", 0)) > link.events.index(("end", 0)),
                           f"{label}: verify first slot after its END")

            good = Link()
            operation(good)
            fails += check(good.slots == {0: images[0], 1: images[1]},
                           f"{label}: successful restore writes both slots")
            fails += check(good.events.index(("read", 0)) < good.events.index(("begin", 1)),
                           f"{label}: first readback precedes second BEGIN")

        no_verify = Link(corrupt=0)
        xs.restore(no_verify, {}, images, verify=False)
        fails += check([e for e in no_verify.events if e[0] == "begin"] == [("begin", 0), ("begin", 1)]
                       and not any(e[0] == "read" for e in no_verify.events),
                       "explicit verify=False retains legacy no-readback behavior")

        only_second = Link(corrupt=0)
        xs.restore(only_second, {}, images, only={2})
        fails += check(only_second.slots == {1: images[1]},
                       "selected slot restore leaves unselected first slot untouched")

        later_bad = Link(corrupt=1)
        try:
            xs.restore(later_bad, {}, images)
            fails += check(False, "second-slot readback mismatch must raise SlotError")
        except xs.SlotError:
            fails += check(later_bad.events.count(("read", 0)) == 1
                           and later_bad.events.count(("read", 1)) == 1,
                           "second-slot mismatch detected after first verified")

    print(f"FAILED_ASSERTIONS={fails}")
    return 1 if fails else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# tools/update.hook parts 1c and 1d on a scratch bare repository with the hooks of this tree (tools/install_server_hooks.sh).
#   1c (check 9, commit.md rule 10): a new branch must be lane/<mb|sb|opt|btr|dk>-<topic>, integration, smk37 or archive/<name>.
#      Cases: tests/host/fixtures/update_names/branches.txt. A branch that was there before (ble-old) can move and be deleted.
#   1d (check 8, rule 10): a push to integration needs git push -o by=merge-integrator. No option, or another by=, is
#      rejected. The quick check of part 2 is a stand-in here (x0x37.quickcheck), so the test checks only the option.
set -u
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_PREFIX GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH GIT_NAMESPACE
TOP="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"; F="$TOP/tests/host/fixtures/update_names/branches.txt"
T=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/updnames.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
fails=0; n=0
B="$T/box.git"; C="$T/c"
printf '#!/bin/bash\n# stand-in quick check\nste_step() { :; }\necho "QUICK PASS stand-in"\n' > "$T/qc.sh"; chmod +x "$T/qc.sh"
git init -q --bare "$B" && git -C "$B" config x0x37.workDir "$T/wd" && git -C "$B" config x0x37.skipLog "$T/skips.log" &&
    git -C "$B" config x0x37.quickcheck "$T/qc.sh" && git -C "$B" config x0x37.gateLock "$T/gate.lock" || { echo "FAIL setup"; exit 1; }
gc() { git -C "$C" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q "$@"; }
git init -q -b integration "$C" && echo a > "$C/a.c" && git -C "$C" add . && gc -m base && git -C "$C" remote add box "$B" &&
    git -C "$C" branch ble-old && git -C "$C" push -q box integration ble-old 2>/dev/null || { echo "FAIL setup: first push"; exit 1; }
bash "$TOP/tools/install_server_hooks.sh" "$B" >/dev/null || { echo "FAIL setup: hooks"; exit 1; }
push() {  # push <accept|reject> <name> <git push args...>
    want=$1; name=$2; shift 2; n=$((n + 1))
    out=$(git -C "$C" push box "$@" 2>&1); rc=$?
    if { [ "$want" = accept ] && [ $rc = 0 ]; } || { [ "$want" = reject ] && [ $rc != 0 ] && echo "$out" | grep -q 'REJECTED'; }; then
        echo "ok   $name: $(echo "$out" | grep -m1 -E 'REJECTED|update hook' | sed 's/^remote: //' | cut -c1-110)"
    else echo "FAIL $name (want $want, rc=$rc)"; echo "$out" | sed 's/^/     /'; fails=$((fails + 1)); fi
}
while IFS='|' read -r want b; do
    case "$want" in "#"*|"") continue;; esac
    push "$want" "new branch $b" "integration:refs/heads/$b"
done < "$F"
echo b >> "$C/a.c"; gc -am "Change b"
push accept "an old branch (ble-old) moves" HEAD:ble-old
push accept "an old branch (ble-old) is deleted" :ble-old
push reject "integration with no push option" integration
push reject "integration with -o by=second-builder" -o by=second-builder integration
push accept "integration with -o by=merge-integrator" -o by=merge-integrator integration
echo c >> "$C/a.c"; gc -am "Change c"
push reject "integration with only a skip option" -o skip-quickcheck="test" integration
push accept "integration with -o by=merge-integrator and a skip" -o by=merge-integrator -o skip-quickcheck="test" integration
echo "update names: $((n - fails)) of $n ok"
[ "$fails" = 0 ]
